description: A live GitHub repository card that pulls public repo stats directly from api.github.com with no authentication required — just owner and repo name. Displays the repo name, description, primary language with a color dot, star count, fork count, watcher count, latest release tag and date, top contributors as a stacked avatar row, and a prominent 'View on GitHub' CTA. Star / fork counts animate up from 0 on first render. Compact or full layout variants, light or dark theme, and configurable toggles for every metadata section so designers can trim what they don't need. Perfect for open-source project marketing sites, developer-tool landing pages, and 'built with' attributions. Graceful loading, error (with retry), and rate-limit states; the component detects 403-with-X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 specifically and suggests waiting 60 minutes. Client-side cache respects the configured interval to keep requests under GitHub's anonymous 60-req/hr-per-IP limit.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML ID for targeting with CSS or JavaScript

props.name: owner
props.description: GitHub username or organization that owns the repo (the part before the slash in the repo URL)

props.name: repo
props.description: Repository name (the part after the slash in the repo URL)

props.name: layout
props.description: Card size and density

props.name: theme
props.description: Visual theme

props.name: cardStyle
props.description: Border / shadow treatment

props.name: showDescription
props.description: Show the repo description below the name

props.name: showLanguage
props.description: Show the primary language with its color dot

props.name: showStars
props.description: Show the star count

props.name: showForks
props.description: Show the fork count

props.name: showWatchers
props.description: Show the watcher count

props.name: showOpenIssues
props.description: Show the open-issue count

props.name: showLatestRelease
props.description: Show the latest release tag and publish date (hides silently if the repo has no releases)

props.name: showLastCommit
props.description: Show the date of the most recent push to the default branch

props.name: showContributors
props.description: Show the top contributors as a stacked avatar row

props.name: maxContributors
props.description: Maximum number of contributor avatars to stack (overflow collapses to a +N pill)

props.name: animateCounts
props.description: Animate star / fork / watcher counts counting up from 0 on first render

props.name: refreshInterval
props.description: Client-side cache duration in minutes (0 disables caching, 5+ recommended to stay under GitHub's anonymous 60-req/hr-per-IP limit)

props.name: openInNewTab
props.description: Open GitHub links in a new browser tab

props.name: showCta
props.description: Show the 'View on GitHub' CTA

props.name: ctaText
props.description: Text on the CTA button

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Text shown while the repo is loading

props.name: errorText
props.description: Generic error message (shown for 4xx / 5xx that isn't a 404 or rate limit)
props.defaultValue: Couldn't load this repository right now. Please try again shortly.

props.name: notFoundText
props.description: Message shown for a 404 — owner/repo combination doesn't exist or is private
props.defaultValue: Repository not found. Check the owner and repo names.

props.name: rateLimitText
props.description: Message shown when GitHub returns 403 with X-RateLimit-Remaining=0
props.defaultValue: GitHub rate limit reached. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.

props.name: retryButtonText
props.description: Text on the retry button

apiIntegrations.notes: No auth needed for public repos. The unauthenticated rate limit is 60 requests/hr per IP — respect refreshInterval. HANDLE THESE STATUS CODES: 200 (render normally), 404 (show notFoundText), 403 with X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 header (show rateLimitText), anything else (show errorText).

Only fetch when showContributors is true. Filter out type === 'Bot' client-side so the dependabot avatar doesn't show. Skip this call entirely (don't even fire it) when showContributors is false to save rate-limit budget. This endpoint can return a 204 No Content for empty repos — handle that as an empty array, not an error.

Only fetch when showLatestRelease is true. A 404 from this endpoint is NORMAL — it means the repo has no releases yet. In that case, silently hide the release section; do NOT surface an error. Any other 4xx/5xx should be logged but also silently hidden (the core repo card is more important than the release section).
